import random

# define neighbor offsets
NEIGHBOR_OFFSETS = [(-1,0),(1,0),(0,-1),(0,1)]

def in_bounds(r,c):
    return 1 <= r <= 19 and 1 <= c <= 19

def get_neighbors(r,c):
    nr = []
    for dr,dc in NEIGHBOR_OFFSETS:
        r2 = r+dr
        c2 = c+dc
        if in_bounds(r2,c2):
            nr.append((r2,c2))
    return nr

def get_group_and_liberties(board, r, c):
    color = board[r][c]
    if color == 0:
        return set(), set()
    stack = [(r,c)]
    visited = set()
    group = set()
    liberties = set()
    while stack:
        cr, cc = stack.pop()
        if (cr,cc) in visited:
            continue
        visited.add((cr,cc))
        group.add((cr,cc))
        for nr,nc in get_neighbors(cr,cc):
            if board[nr][nc] == 0:
                liberties.add((nr,nc))
            elif board[nr][nc] == color:
                if (nr,nc) not in visited:
                    stack.append((nr,nc))
    return group, liberties

def simulate(board, r, c, color):
    # returns (new_board, captured_stones) or (None,0) if illegal (suicide)
    new_board = [row[:] for row in board]
    new_board[r][c] = color
    opp = -color
    captured = 0
    # Check opponent groups adjacent to placed stone
    for nr,nc in get_neighbors(r,c):
        if new_board[nr][nc] == opp:
            # compute group liberties
            group, liberties = get_group_and_liberties(new_board, nr, nc)
            if len(liberties) == 0:
                # capture this group
                for gr,gc in group:
                    new_board[gr][gc] = 0
                captured += len(group)
    # after possible capture, check own liberties
    own_group, own_libs = get_group_and_liberties(new_board, r, c)
    if len(own_libs) == 0:
        # illegal (suicide)
        return None, 0
    return new_board, captured

def is_legal(board, r, c, color):
    new_board, _ = simulate(board, r, c, color)
    return new_board is not None
